# USGS Water Data APIs fixtures

Recorded 2026-11-08 with `curl`, no API key, no custom headers other than `User-Agent`. Files keep the
source's JSON; none was edited. Each file is the response body of the URL on its line.
Base URL: `https://api.waterdata.usgs.gov`. See `docs/providers/usgs.md` for field tables.

- `usgs-monitoring-locations-bbox-manhattan-st.json` — `https://api.waterdata.usgs.gov/ogcapi/v1/collections/monitoring-locations/items?f=json&bbox=-74.05,40.68,-73.95,40.80&site_type_code=ST&limit=50&properties=id,monitoring_location_name,monitoring_location_number,site_type_code,hydrologic_unit_code,drainage_area,altitude,vertical_datum,time_zone_abbreviation,uses_daylight_savings` (2026-11-08)
